notes: v1.14.558 — THE OPS ROW COMES BACK. Build's tool door has not existed on the shipped app since v1.14.473, and nothing ever said so. ⛔ HOW IT WENT MISSING: .473 (c199f43) removed the ops_init() call from showMode('work') and wrote that OPS 'will be triggered on-demand when user taps the OPS control, not at boot time'. THAT TRIGGER WAS NEVER WIRED. ops_init has had ZERO callers since — the banner it builds was never inserted, so the ten OPS tools it fronts had no door on Build, and the owner ruling of 2026-08-19 that Build's tool door IS the OPS row was quietly not in effect for 85 versions. ⭐ AN INTENDED DEFERRAL LANDED AS A DELETION, and it hid perfectly: the absence of a control is indistinguishable from a control you have not navigated to yet. No throw, no warning, no failing test — the IA-SHIFTNAV Phase 0 census is what found it, by measuring for the banner and not finding it. ⚠ CORRECTING .473's OWN DIAGNOSIS: it blamed 'phantom-api CORS errors'. Inserting a DOM node cannot cause CORS — that was a coincident harness failure (the test origin is not on the Worker's allowlist), not causation. The real cause is the second half of its note: the banner was inserted as the FIRST CHILD of #bw-shell while bw_render's WebGL and layout work was still settling. THE FIX IS THE TIMING .473 PRESCRIBED AND DID NOT APPLY — ops_init runs behind a double requestAnimationFrame, so Build has laid out before the row goes in. Its own bwShell guard still refuses to run early, and ops_renderPanels stays lazy: it runs on expand or on a restored expanded state, never on a collapsed boot. ⭐ This is the prerequisite ship for IA-SHIFTNAV Ship 1 (owner rulings V-1 and 1a, 2026-08-31): Ship 1 puts the ten buried tools behind Build's door, and this restores the door for it to land on. Pinned by 48-ops-row-exists, 4 tests, mutation-proven.
